uses: p. 1, legislative summary: expands non-consensual intimate-image rules to electronic representations likely to be mistaken for recordings of an identifiable person.
p. 15, proposed Criminal Code s. 162.1(1.1)-(2): threats to publish and an expanded intimate-image definition covering synthetic visual representations.
p. 15, proposed penalty: indictable route up to 10 years, or summary conviction.
refs.verification: Official bill text; not treated as enacted or in force.
